about: The look builder (the series form's Look): a row per part of the look, each option a clause of the cinematographer's brief the builder writes into style.look (compose_look: the medium, then the other parts' clauses joined by semicolons). A medium that is drawn or animated (`drawn`) folds the camera, lens and film rows away. The picks are kept in style.look_parts; the line stays the series' own to edit. The sample pictures are img/look_builder/<row>-<option>.jpg, each the look presets' scene in a live-action base with only that option set (made by tools/make_preset_samples.py).
